assign.brief: Migrate old-style tasks into the new Task system (core/Task): research, plan, build, test, dry run. Real run waits for voice-app.

log.msg: research (Sonnet, $1.72) + plan approved; TaskMigrate.mjs built, 9/9 tests on a frozen copy; rehearsal on a full copy: 211 moved, 0 check problems, rerun no-op; real-tree dry run saved as dry-run.md. Real run waits for voice-app.

assign.now: dry run clean; waiting for voice-app to say run it for real

findings.text: `requirements.md` does not exist in task-migrate/, so I judged the diff against plan.md and its stated intent (stop writing `source`; put the brief path in `brief`), not against the owner's words.

Server/TaskMigrate.mjs:18-19 — `set.brief` is written after the `OWN_KEYS` filter, and `brief` is not in `OWN_KEYS`, so the old `data.brief` is copied through and then overwritten by the computed one. That is fine. The `source` fallback only triggers when a "/" is present, so a non-path old `source` such as a name is dropped silently.

Server/TaskMigrate.test.mjs:66 checks only that line 1 has no `source`. Nothing asserts that `brief` lands in the `set` line, so the new behaviour is not covered. A one-line `assert` on the `set` would close that.

"source" stays in `OWN_KEYS` (Server/TaskMigrate.mjs:30), so an old `data.source` is never copied as `source`. That matches the plan, but an existing `Task.FIELDS` or reader that still expects line-1 `source` is not checked here.

answer.reply: noted: the brief is the session prompt plus plan.md; the owner's words are in owner-2026-10-16-migration.md, linked from line 1
fixed: an old source with no '/' is a who-asked name and now stays source on line 1 (8d1b41ce5 follow-up)
fixed: the apply test now counts moves whose replayed home has data.brief and asserts at least one
noted: Task.FIELDS keeps source; only migrated homes omit it, per mastermind-task-system (step 3d fills it by node)

assign.now: real run: --apply on the main tree (go from mastermind-checkup-task-system)
